title: Nana Asma'u
tagline: The girl who learned the Qur'an by heart, and grew up to teach a whole land: the woman this site is named after.
depictionNotes: Nana Asma'u (about 1793 to 1864), her father the Shehu Usman dan Fodio and the people around her are shown, all with dark skin. The Prophet ﷺ is mentioned and never shown; Asma bint Abi Bakr, a Companion, is shown only from behind and by her hands. Until the story's pictures are made, scenes are drawn with simple icons. The facts come from Boyd and Mack's Collected Works of Nana Asma'u (1997) and other named sources; the war years and the captives are not told to children, and each chapter's note for parents says so.
